name: SOL Emergency Bivvy with rescue whistle
summary: A compact reflective emergency bivvy for a temporary weather barrier. It is not an insulated sleeping system or a guarantee against hypothermia; confirm the size and package variant.
description: An emergency bivvy takes little kit space, but its role needs to be clear before a trip. Treat this model as a temporary barrier while arranging safer shelter, insulation and help. Choose clothing and ground insulation for the expected conditions rather than relying on a reflective percentage. Check that the standard size fits the intended user and keep it accessible rather than buried under other supplies.

pros: A small packed format leaves space for other emergency supplies.
An orange version offers visibility when a temporary shelter is needed.
cons: Reflective material is not equivalent to insulating loft.
Condensation, damage and fit can limit practical use.
Standard, XL and Escape models have different designs and must not share specifications.
useCases: Carry a temporary weather barrier alongside appropriate clothing, ground insulation and a communication plan.
Prepare for an unexpected delay while seeking safer shelter and professional assistance when needed.
